summary.text: Son of Ixion, Lapith king and comrade of Theseus, numbered among the Argonauts in Hyginus' catalogue.

story.text: Hyginus names Pirithous son of Ixion among the Thessalian Minyae who sailed for the fleece; he is better known for the Calydonian hunt and for descending with Theseus to fetch Persephone.
